items.title: AI也動到高階主管！BMW擬砍兩成高階管理職位
items.title_en: AI Also Targets Senior Executives! BMW Plans to Cut 20% of Senior Management Positions
paras: BMW周三(30日)表示，計劃運用人工智慧(AI)，在明年中以前削減20%的高階管理職位，並整併部門、精簡組織，以降低成本、改善獲利。這項措施是已達成協議的自願離職方案之一，組織調整也將延伸至較低管理層級。
據《彭博》報導，BMW董事會下方約有65名資深副總裁，再下一層約有400名高階主管，預計約100個高階職位將遭裁撤。執行長聶科維(Milan Nedeljkovic)表示，多數職位位於慕尼黑。
BMW於7月達成削減德國白領職位的協議。知情人士當時透露，目標約為8,000人，相當於全球員工的5%。公司正面臨中國市場低迷與中東衝突衝擊，並罕見地明確將AI列為精簡管理人力的工具。
財務長Walter Mertl表示，在全公司持續導入AI代理應用，將有助提高開發效率、精簡組織及加快決策。UPS(UPS-US)先前也曾削減1.2萬名管理人員，並表示AI將使這些職位不再恢復。
此次資本市場日，是聶科維於5月接任後，首次向投資人完整說明獲利復甦策略。BMW於6月發布獲利預警，稱今年汽車業務利潤率可能降至1%。公司如今設定2028年回升至3%至5%，並在下一個十年初重返8%至10%的長期目標區間。
除削減人力外，BMW也因優先事項調整，退出下月巴黎車展，並依各地需求重整產品陣容。在中國，消費者日益轉向比亞迪(01211-HK)等本土品牌，促使BMW調整布局。
BMW另計劃推出定位介於BMW與旗下勞斯萊斯(Rolls-Royce)之間的車款，爭取頂級買家，可能與賓士的Maybach競爭；同時為歐洲開發入門電動車、為美國推出高階休旅車，並停產2-Series Active Tourer及3系列柴油轎車等車型，以降低產品複雜度。
paras_en: BMW said on Wednesday (the 30th) that it plans to use artificial intelligence (AI) to reduce senior management positions by 20% before mid‑next year, consolidating departments and streamlining the organization to cut costs and improve profitability. The measure is part of a voluntary exit program already agreed upon, and the restructuring will also extend to lower management levels.

According to Bloomberg, about 65 senior vice‑presidents sit directly under BMW’s board, with roughly 400 senior managers in the next layer, and around 100 senior roles are expected to be eliminated. CEO Milan Nedeljkovic said most of the positions are based in Munich.

BMW reached an agreement in July to cut white‑collar jobs in Germany. At the time, insiders said the target was about 8,000 people, roughly 5% of the global workforce. The company is facing a weak Chinese market and the impact of Middle‑East conflicts, and unusually cites AI explicitly as a tool for trimming management headcount.

Chief Financial Officer Walter Mertl said the ongoing rollout of AI agents across the company will help boost development efficiency, streamline the organization and accelerate decision‑making. UPS (UPS‑US) previously cut 12,000 managers and said AI would make those roles unnecessary to restore.

The capital‑markets day was Nedeljkovic’s first full briefing to investors since taking over in May, outlining the profit‑recovery strategy. BMW issued a profit warning in June, saying automotive margin could fall to 1% this year. The company now aims to lift it to 3‑5% by 2028 and return to the long‑term target range of 8‑10% in the early part of the next decade.

In addition to workforce cuts, BMW is adjusting priorities by withdrawing from next month’s Paris Motor Show and reshuffling its product lineup to match regional demand. In China, consumers are increasingly shifting to local brands such as BYD (01211‑HK), prompting BMW to rethink its positioning.

BMW also plans to launch a model positioned between its core BMW brand and its Rolls‑Royce subsidiary to attract top‑tier buyers, potentially competing with Mercedes‑Benz’s Maybach. At the same time, it will develop an entry‑level electric car for Europe, a premium SUV for the United States, and discontinue the 2‑Series Active Tourer and 3‑Series diesel sedans to reduce product complexity.

items.title: 川普緊咬鮑爾！超支10億美元卻未見犯罪依據 Fed整修案調查揭管理漏洞
items.title_en: Trump Takes Aim at Powell! $1 B Overrun Yet No Criminal Basis Found; Fed Renovation Probe Exposes Management Gaps
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)總部整修案調查結果出爐。Fed監察長周三(30日)公布報告，指出這項目前造價約24億美元的工程存在重大管理與監督缺失，導致成本較最初預算增加約10億美元，但未發現須移送司法部的聯邦刑事違法依據，也未認定行政不當行為。
綜合外媒報導，整修案曾成為川普政府抨擊前Fed主席鮑爾的重要焦點，並引發刑事調查與央行獨立性爭議。現任主席華許表示，Fed將落實報告建議，由美國總務署(GSA)主導後續工程管理，並聘請獨立稽核機構檢查迄今已授予合約的費用。

未發現犯罪依據 工程超支暴露管理缺失

此次調查涵蓋Fed位於華盛頓的兩棟歷史建築整修工程，包括原有總部Eccles大樓及鄰近一棟1931年建成的聯邦建築。工程原先於2020年編列約13億美元預算，目前成本已增至約24億美元。Fed先前表示，整修旨在更新老舊設施，並藉整合辦公據點降低長期營運成本。
監察長報告指出，Fed未落實原本打算採用的「保證最高價格」合約安排，未能確立由承包商承擔超支責任的成本上限。截至今年7月，工程啟動已四年、相關合約也已授出，仍未訂出保證最高價格。
此外，部分工程缺乏競標，內部治理架構也不足以管理如此龐大且複雜的計畫。Fed未落實先前另一項建築整修案的改善建議，包括明訂成本限制及要求施工成本估算。此次工程的水管與空調費用最終達3.46億美元，約為最初估計的三倍。
設計變更、現場環境及通膨也是成本增加的原因。鮑爾先前曾指出，石綿清除、地下施工，以及材料和人工價格高於預期，都推升工程支出。至於白宮批評的大理石、水景與花園露台等設計，報告認定並未實質造成成本大幅增加。
報告強調，評估過程中未發現合理依據，足以認為存在須移送美國司法部長的聯邦刑事違法行為，也未認定行政不當行為。監察長雖檢視與鮑爾國會證詞有關的資料，但此次評估並非專門判定他是否作偽證，報告也未提出證詞涉及不當行為的認定。

華許承諾落實改善 總務署接手工程管理

華許在隨報告公布的回函中表示，Fed將採納監察長建議，並由負責聯邦政府建築事務的GSA主導後續工程，向Fed理事會及華許報告。
Fed也將聘請獨立稽核機構，檢查迄今所有已授予合約的費用，確認其準確性與合規性。報告另建議，Fed應確保剩餘工程取得最佳價值，建立衡量成本與進度的標準，並明確授權監督單位追蹤執行情況。
華許表示，此案有重要教訓值得汲取，監察長結論與GSA建議，將對未來Fed理事會成員具有長期參考價值。

整修爭議牽動Fed獨立性 鮑爾去留仍受關注

川普長期批評鮑爾未依其要求降息，整修案成本攀升後，白宮與部分共和黨議員進一步指控Fed浪費資金、採用奢華設計。鮑爾於2025年7月要求監察長重新檢視工程及成本，川普同月也曾親赴工地，與鮑爾就工程費用當面交鋒。
爭議在今年1月升高，鮑爾公開表示，司法部已向Fed發出大陪審團傳票，並威脅提出刑事起訴。他指控，調查實際上是為了施壓Fed，迫使央行依總統偏好調整利率。
聯邦法官3月撤銷相關傳票，認定有證據顯示其目的在於施壓鮑爾降息或辭職，卻未發現鮑爾涉及不法的證據。華盛頓聯邦檢察官皮洛(Jeanine Pirro)於4月停止調查，為華許接任主席掃除障礙，但也表示，若事實支持，不排除重啟刑事調查。
華許5月接任後，鮑爾仍留任Fed理事，其任期至2028年1月。鮑爾先前表示，在調查真正且徹底結束、具備透明度與明確結論之前，不會離開理事會。此次報告公布後，鮑爾未予置評，是否影響其去留仍待觀察。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve’s headquarters renovation investigation results have been released. The Fed’s Inspector General announced the report on Wednesday (the 30th), noting that the roughly $2.4 billion project suffers from significant management and oversight failures, causing costs to rise by about $1 billion over the original budget, but no federal criminal violations warranting a referral to the Justice Department were found, nor was any administrative misconduct identified.

According to foreign media, the renovation became a focal point for the Trump administration’s attacks on former Fed Chair Jerome Powell, sparking criminal investigations and debates over central‑bank independence. Current Chair Lisa Cook Williams said the Fed will implement the report’s recommendations, with the U.S. General Services Administration taking charge of the remaining project management and an independent audit firm reviewing all contracts awarded to date.

No Criminal Basis Found; Cost Overrun Highlights Management Gaps
The probe covered the renovation of two historic Fed buildings in Washington, D.C., the original Eccles headquarters and a neighboring 1931‑era federal building. The project was initially budgeted at about $1.3 billion in 2020 and has now swelled to roughly $2.4 billion. The Fed previously said the work was meant to modernize aging facilities and, by consolidating office space, lower long‑term operating costs.

The Inspector General’s report said the Fed failed to implement the originally intended “guaranteed maximum price” contract structure, which would have capped contractor liability for overruns. As of July this year, four years after the project began and after contracts were awarded, no guaranteed‑maximum‑price arrangement had been set.

In addition, some work was performed without competitive bidding, and the internal governance framework was insufficient to oversee a project of this size and complexity. The Fed also did not follow prior recommendations from another building‑renovation review, such as explicitly setting cost limits and requiring construction‑cost estimates. Plumbing and HVAC expenses alone total $346 million, about three times the original estimate.

Design changes, site conditions and inflation also drove up costs. Powell had previously noted that asbestos removal, underground work, and higher‑than‑expected material and labor prices pushed spending higher. The report found that the White House‑criticized marble, water features and garden terraces did not materially inflate the overall cost.

The report emphasized that the evaluation found no reasonable basis to conclude that federal criminal violations requiring a referral to the Justice Department existed, nor did it identify administrative misconduct. While the Inspector General reviewed material related to Powell’s congressional testimony, the assessment was not a specific perjury determination and did not label his testimony as improper.
Williams pledged to act on the improvements, with the GSA taking over project management

The Fed will also hire an independent audit firm to examine all contracts awarded to date, verifying their accuracy and compliance. The report further recommends that the Fed ensure the remaining work delivers best value, establish standards for measuring cost and schedule performance, and explicitly empower oversight units to track implementation.
Williams said the case offers important lessons, and that the Inspector General’s conclusions and the GSA’s suggestions will provide long‑term reference value for future Fed Board members.

Renovation controversy touches Fed independence; Powell’s future remains under scrutiny
Trump has long criticized Powell for not cutting rates at his request. After the renovation costs surged, the White House and some Republican lawmakers accused the Fed of wasteful spending and lavish design. Powell asked the Inspector General in July 2025 to re‑examine the project and its costs, and Trump visited the site that same month to confront Powell over the expenses.

The dispute intensified in January 2024 when Powell publicly said the Justice Department had issued a grand‑jury subpoena to the Fed and threatened criminal prosecution. He alleged the investigation was intended to pressure the Fed to adjust rates in line with the president’s preferences.

A federal judge in March dismissed the subpoena, finding evidence that its purpose was to pressure Powell to cut rates or resign, but no evidence of wrongdoing by Powell. Washington federal prosecutor Jeanine Pirro halted the investigation in April, clearing the way for Williams’s appointment, though she noted that a restart of criminal probes would not be ruled out if facts warranted.

Since Williams took office in May, Powell remains a Fed Board member, with his term running until January 2028. Powell has said he will not leave the Board until the investigation is truly and thoroughly concluded with transparency and clear findings. He has not commented on the report’s release, and whether it will affect his tenure remains to be seen.

items.title: AI代理闖禍、監管出手！FTC調查OpenAI與Anthropic
items.title_en: AI Agents Cause Trouble, Regulators Step In! FTC Investigates OpenAI and Anthropic
paras: 美國聯邦貿易委員會(FTC)正對OpenAI、Anthropic及其他人工智慧(AI)業者展開全產業調查，檢視產品安全與對消費者的潛在風險。近期AI代理入侵第三方系統的事件接連曝光，加深華府與矽谷對技術失控的疑慮。
綜合外媒周三(30日)報導，FTC準備在未來數周向相關業者發出正式資料要求，調查企業是否遵守消費者保護法。FTC高階官員表示，調查也將涵蓋AI研究機構METR，並要求主要開發商高層作證。這是美國首次正式針對失控AI代理採取監管調查行動。
7月，OpenAI一套AI代理系統入侵開源平台Hugging Face。官員表示，代理先探查漏洞，再發動大規模攻擊，使FTC更加急於處理相關風險。過去數周，OpenAI也陸續通知政府與大學，其網站曾在模型訓練期間遭存取。
FTC主席Andrew Ferguson上周表示，若開發商在資安測試中指示代理的行為導致駭侵，就應對造成的損害負責。消息人士指出，他在Hugging Face事件前，已對相關企業抱持疑慮。OpenAI與Anthropic均未立即回應置評。
川普周二與主要AI企業高層會面，業者同意建立自願性標準。川普為優先確保美國在AI領域的主導地位，多次稱相關恐懼是騙局，但也表示，政府可依現行法律追究AI企業造成的損害。
FTC負責執行反壟斷與消費者保護法，長期關注資安及資料外洩，過去案件曾使企業支付數十億美元，但調查也可能以不採取行動結案。去年，FTC另曾要求Alphabet(GOOGL-US)(GOOG-US)旗下Google、OpenAI、Meta(META-US)等業者提供資料，檢視AI聊天機器人對兒童的影響。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) is conducting an industry‑wide investigation of OpenAI, Anthropic and other artificial‑intelligence (AI) firms, examining product safety and potential risks to consumers. Recent incidents of AI agents infiltrating third‑party systems have been repeatedly exposed, deepening Washington’s and Silicon Valley’s concerns about technology getting out of control.

According to foreign media reports on Wednesday the 30th, the FTC plans to issue formal information requests to the relevant companies in the coming weeks to investigate whether they are complying with consumer‑protection laws. A senior FTC official said the probe will also cover the AI research institute METR and will require senior executives of the main developers to testify. This is the first time the United States has formally launched a regulatory investigation into runaway AI agents.

In July, an OpenAI AI‑agent system breached the open‑source platform Hugging Face. Officials said the agent first probed for vulnerabilities and then launched a large‑scale attack, prompting the FTC to accelerate its response to the associated risks. In recent weeks OpenAI has also repeatedly notified the government and universities that its website was accessed during model‑training periods.

FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson said last week that if developers direct agents to behave in ways that lead to hacking during security testing, they should be held liable for the resulting damage. Sources indicated that he had already harbored doubts about the companies before the Hugging Face incident. Neither OpenAI nor Anthropic responded immediately to comment.

Former President Trump met on Tuesday with senior executives of major AI companies, and the firms agreed to develop voluntary standards. Trump, who is keen to ensure the United States maintains a leading position in AI, has repeatedly called related fears a hoax, but also said the government can pursue AI companies for damages under existing laws.

The FTC, which enforces antitrust and consumer‑protection statutes, has long monitored cybersecurity and data‑leak issues, and past cases have forced companies to pay tens of billions of dollars, though investigations can also be closed without action. Last year the FTC also asked Alphabet (GOOGL‑US)(GOOG‑US)‑owned Google, OpenAI, Meta (META‑US) and others to provide data to assess the impact of AI chatbots on children.

items.title: 晶片設計也有大生意！新思科技拿下AWS逾10億美元合約
items.title_en: Chip Design Also Has Big Business! Synopsys Secures Over $1 Billion AWS Contract
paras: 新思科技(SNPS-US)與亞馬遜(AMZN-US)旗下雲端運算事業Amazon Web Services(AWS)周三(30日)宣布，雙方簽署價值逾10億美元的多年期協議，由AWS取得新思科技的晶片設計矽智財(IP)授權，進一步深化雙方在晶片開發與雲端服務的合作。
據《路透》報導，新思科技主要提供複雜晶片的設計軟體，協助輝達(NVDA-US)、英特爾(INTC-US)等業者，在僅數平方毫米的矽晶片上配置數百億個電晶體。近年公司也積極擴大晶片零組件設計的授權業務，讓客戶直接採用既有設計，減少自行開發的成本與時間。
這項設計授權業務在新思科技最近一個會計年度創造17.5億美元營收，並與安謀(ARM-US)競爭。
新思科技早期的IP授權主要聚焦晶片中的通用零組件，客戶購買現成設計，往往比從零開始開發更符合成本效益。如今，公司已將業務拓展至運算核心等更複雜的設計，此次與AWS的協議將聚焦針對特定晶片類型最佳化的設計方案。
AWS目前自行開發多款晶片，包括Graviton中央處理器與Trainium AI晶片。不過，雙方並未透露哪些AWS晶片將採用新思科技的設計。
作為協議的一部分，新思科技也將採用AWS的運算與儲存服務，並使用Amazon Bedrock建置及部署AI應用。
paras_en: Synopsys (SNPS-US) and Amazon Web Services (AWS), the cloud computing arm of Amazon (AMZN-US), announced on Wednesday (the 30th) that the two companies have signed a multi‑year agreement worth more than $1 billion, under which AWS will obtain licensing rights to Synopsys’s chip‑design intellectual property (IP), deepening their collaboration on chip development and cloud services.

According to Reuters, Synopsys primarily provides design software for complex chips, helping companies such as Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Intel (INTC-US) pack hundreds of billions of transistors onto silicon chips only a few square millimetres in size. In recent years the firm has also been actively expanding its licensing business for chip component designs, allowing customers to adopt existing designs directly and reduce the cost and time of developing their own.
This design‑licensing business generated $1.75 billion in revenue for Synopsys in its most recent fiscal year, putting it in competition with Arm (ARM-US).

Synopsys’s early IP licensing focused on generic components within chips, with customers buying off‑the‑shelf designs that are often more cost‑effective than building from scratch. The company has now expanded into more complex designs such as compute cores, and the AWS deal will centre on design solutions optimized for specific chip types.

AWS currently develops several of its own chips, including the Graviton central processing unit and the Trainium AI chip. However, the parties did not disclose which AWS chips will incorporate Synopsys’s designs.
As part of the agreement, Synopsys will also use AWS’s compute and storage services and employ Amazon Bedrock to build and deploy AI applications.

items.title: 不必全押也不用全賣！巴隆教6招分散AI曝險又不錯過AI行情
items.title_en: No Need to Go All-In or Sell Everything! Barron's Offers Six Ways to Diversify AI Exposure Without Missing the AI Rally
paras: 人工智慧(AI)可能是改變全球經濟的技術之一，但也代表投資人面臨前所未有的風險，Anthropic甚至在首次公開發行(IPO)文件中提出AI可能導致人類滅絕的可能性，使投資人重新思考如何管理AI相關風險。
面對AI究竟會帶來生產力提升，還是引發監管衝擊甚至更極端的結果，投資人不一定只能選擇「全部賣出」或「全面押注」兩條路，以下是巴隆周刊(Barron’s)提出的六種風險管理方式：

1、提高現金部位

最簡單的方法是賣出部分股票、提高現金比重。雖然這可能讓投資人在AI行情持續時錯失部分漲幅，但也能降低市場大幅波動時的投資組合曝險。

2、調整投資組合權重

投資人可以降低大型AI科技股在投資組合中的比重，例如將市值加權的SPDR S&P 500 ETF部分資金，轉往Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF，降低大型科技股對整體投資組合的影響。
CappThesis創辦人兼市場技術分析師Frank Cappelleri表示，大型科技股的強勢表現已使標普500相對於等權重指數呈現「超買」。他強調，這並非對估值做基本面判斷，而是觀察股價走勢與市場歷史，作為降低曝險時機的參考。

3、分散AI投資曝險

AI產業不只涉及晶片與大型科技公司，投資人也可以將AI相關曝險分散至銅、散熱、晶片、運算等不同領域，避免投資集中在單一環節。
另一種方式是「槓鈴策略」，也就是一端大量配置AI相關股票，例如SpaceX(SPCX-US)，另一端配置非AI股票，例如民生必需品。高盛也曾建議關注「重資產、低淘汰率」(HALO)股票，也就是即使AI發展出現變化，仍可能持續存在的企業。
不過，各種策略都有利弊。波音(BA-US)就是HALO股票之一，但該公司本身也面臨生產與品質問題，股價目前仍較2019年歷史高點下跌逾50%。

4、透過選擇權降低風險

投資人也可以針對持有的股票賣出買權(Call Option)，藉此取得現金。這類選擇權策略較為複雜，通常由經驗較豐富的投資人採用。

5、選擇相對不受AI影響的企業

Melius Research分析師Ben Reitzes表示，如果AI發展速度放緩，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與微軟(MSFT-US)的核心業務受到的干擾相對較少，因此部分投資人可能將兩家公司視為相對安全的選擇。
他也指出，蘋果(AAPL-US)在許多投資組合中具有避險作用，因為蘋果感覺像是一家「與模型無關」的企業，同時也能成為AI普及的入口。

6、留意AI監管與產業自律

AI監管可能成為另一項影響投資風險的因素，可能方案包括成立類似美國食品藥物管理局(FDA)的專家機構，評估AI模型的安全性與有效性。也有人提出類似核武管制的全球合作，以及對AI查詢課徵代幣稅等構想。
產業自律也是其中一種方式。輝達(NVDA-US)本周宣布成立「Nvidia Open Agent Safety Platform」，被視為由產業主導的自我監管措施。
不過，Melius的Reitzes指出，即使Anthropic與OpenAI等大型企業受到監管，開源模型仍會持續增加，因此AI產業仍需要持續自我監督。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) may be one of the technologies that reshapes the global economy, but it also brings investors unprecedented risks; Anthropic even warned in its IPO filing that AI could lead to human extinction, prompting investors to rethink how to manage AI‑related risk.

Facing the question of whether AI will boost productivity, trigger regulatory backlash, or lead to more extreme outcomes, investors don’t have to choose only between "sell everything" or "bet everything". Below are six risk‑management approaches suggested by Barron's.

1. Increase cash holdings. The simplest method is to sell some stocks and raise the cash proportion. While this may cause investors to miss part of the upside during an AI rally, it also reduces portfolio exposure when the market swings sharply.

2. Adjust portfolio weightings. Investors can lower the share of large AI tech stocks in their portfolios, for example shifting some capital from the market‑cap‑weighted SPDR S&P 500 ETF to the Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight ETF, thereby reducing the impact of big‑tech stocks on the overall portfolio.

Frank Cappelleri, founder of CappThesis and market technical analyst, said the strong performance of large‑cap tech stocks has made the S&P 500 appear "overbought" relative to the equal‑weight index. He stressed that this is not a fundamental valuation judgment but an observation of price trends and market history to help time exposure reductions.

3. Diversify AI investment exposure. The AI sector spans not only chips and large tech firms but also copper, cooling, semiconductor, and computing segments, allowing investors to spread AI risk across different areas rather than concentrating on a single link.

Another approach is the "barbell strategy," allocating heavily to AI‑related stocks such as SpaceX (SPCX‑US) on one end and to non‑AI stocks like consumer staples on the other. Goldman Sachs has also suggested focusing on "high‑asset, low‑obsolescence" (HALO) stocks—companies that would likely persist even if AI development shifts.
However, each strategy has pros and cons. Boeing (BA‑US) is an example of a HALO stock, yet it faces production and quality issues, and its share price is still down more than 50% from its 2019 peak.

4. Use options to lower risk. Investors can sell call options on stocks they hold to generate cash. This type of options strategy is more complex and is typically employed by more experienced investors.

5. Choose companies relatively less affected by AI. Melius Research analyst Ben Reitzes noted that if AI development slows, the core businesses of Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Microsoft (MSFT‑US) would be less disrupted, making them relatively safe picks for some investors.
He also pointed out that Apple (AAPL‑US) serves as a hedge in many portfolios because it feels like a "model‑agnostic" company while also acting as an entry point for AI adoption.

6. Watch AI regulation and industry self‑regulation. AI oversight could become another risk factor, with proposals ranging from creating an FDA‑like expert agency to assess AI model safety and efficacy, to global nuclear‑style cooperation and even token taxes on AI queries.
Industry self‑regulation is another avenue. Nvidia (NVDA‑US) announced this week the launch of the "Nvidia Open Agent Safety Platform," seen as an industry‑led self‑governance measure.

Nevertheless, Reitzes of Melius warned that even if large firms like Anthropic and OpenAI face regulation, open‑source models will keep proliferating, so the AI sector will still need ongoing self‑monitoring.

items.title: 12億美元AI大單到手！慧與科技上調網路事業成長預期
items.title_en: US$1.2 Billion AI Deal Secured! HPE Raises Growth Outlook for Its Networking Business
paras: 慧與科技(HPE-US)周三(30日)宣布，取得雲端業者Vultr價值12億美元的AI設備訂單，並上調網路事業的長期營收成長預期。AI需求帶動伺服器與網路設備銷售，激勵HPE盤前股價上漲近6%，今年以來股價已漲逾一倍。
截稿前，慧與科技周三盤中股價上漲3.61%，每股暫報63.71美元。
綜合外媒報導，HPE將在Vultr的美國資料中心部署超微(AMD-US)Helios AI機櫃，整合AI晶片、HPE網路交換器與軟體，這也是HPE首次取得這套系統的訂單。
總部位於佛州的Vultr獲AMD支持，過去三年與Juniper Networks合作；HPE於2025年收購Juniper後，進一步擴大網路事業布局。
HPE在網路事業投資人日表示，預估2026至2029會計年度的網路事業營收年複合成長率，將達接近20%的十位數百分比高段，較先前針對2025至2028會計年度預估的5%至7%明顯提高。
公司也將2027會計年度網路事業營收成長預估，由14%至17%，上調至接近20%至略高於20%的區間，並將Juniper收購案相關成本節省目標，由至少6億美元提高至2028會計年度底達到每年8億美元的節省規模。
HPE網路事業主管Rami Rahim表示，AI正在重塑科技架構，讓網路的策略重要性提高，並帶動企業與服務供應商的大量新需求。
隨著客戶增購伺服器與網路產品，以支援ChatGPT等AI應用，HPE成為AI硬體需求的重要受惠者，並與戴爾(DELL-US)、美超微(SMCI-US)競逐商機。旗下網路事業主要提供連接伺服器、資料中心及其他設備與軟體應用的產品和服務。
paras_en: HPE announced on Wednesday the acquisition of a US$1.2 billion AI equipment order from cloud provider Vultr and raised its long‑term revenue growth outlook for the networking business. AI demand is driving server and networking equipment sales, lifting HPE’s pre‑market share by nearly 6% and more than doubling its stock price year‑to‑date.
Before market close, HPE’s share price was up 3.61% intraday, temporarily reporting $63.71 per share.

According to foreign media reports, HPE will deploy AMD (AMD‑US) Helios AI cabinets in Vultr’s U.S. data centers, integrating AI chips, HPE networking switches and software; this is HPE’s first order for this system.

Vultr, headquartered in Florida, is backed by AMD and has partnered with Juniper Networks for the past three years; after HPE’s 2025 acquisition of Juniper, it will further expand its networking footprint.

At the networking business investor day, HPE said it now expects the FY2026‑2029 networking‑segment revenue compound annual growth rate to be close to the high‑double‑digit range near 20%, a marked increase from the prior FY2025‑2028 estimate of 5%‑7%.

The company also raised its FY2027 networking‑segment revenue growth forecast from 14%‑17% to roughly 20%‑slightly above 20%, and lifted the cost‑saving target from the Juniper acquisition from at least $600 million to $800 million per year by FY2028.
HPE networking chief Rami Rahim said AI is reshaping technology architecture, elevating the strategic importance of networking and driving massive new demand from enterprises and service providers.

As customers increase purchases of servers and networking products to support AI applications such as ChatGPT, HPE has become a major beneficiary of AI hardware demand, competing with Dell (DELL‑US) and Super Micro (SMCI‑US). Its networking segment primarily provides products and services that connect servers, data centers and other equipment to software applications.

items.title: 凱基金擬辦現金增資最多250億元 7成以上將挹注凱基證券
items.title_en: KGI Fund Plans Up to NT$250 Billion Cash Capital Increase, Over 70% to Be Invested in KGI Securities
paras: 凱基金控(2883-TW)今(30)日董事會通過辦理現金增資發行普通股案，發行股數以不超過7.2億股為限，預計募資規模約新台幣200億元至250億元，實際募資金額將依最終訂定之發行價格而定，本次規劃將有七成以上資金投入凱基證券。
凱基金控表示，受惠於AI產業發展帶動台灣經濟成長，以及資本市場持續活絡，企業籌資、財富管理及金融商品交易需求穩健成長。為掌握市場發展契機及支應業務擴張所需資本，本次增資資金規劃將有七成以上投入凱基證券，進一步強化業務發展及市場競爭力。此舉除有助於擴大核心業務規模，更可提升集團資本運用效率及未來獲利成長動能。
凱基證券今年前8月各項業務動能持續強勁，累計稅後純益達227.54億元，續創歷年同期新高，較去年同期成長235%，年化股東權益報酬率達44%領先同業。在投資銀行業務方面，深耕AI及半導體等核心產業，前八月主辦承銷總金額市占率接近四成，穩居市場第一；財富管理業務持續拓展台灣及香港市場，營收維持強勁成長；衍生性商品及股票期權等交易業務亦靈活掌握市場機會，持續挹注獲利貢獻。
凱基金控表示，本次增資除支應凱基證券未來業務發展所需資本外，也展現集團持續優化資本配置、聚焦高成長及高資本效率業務的策略方向。未來將持續透過審慎且積極的資本管理，強化核心競爭優勢，提升集團整體獲利能力與股東價值。
本次現金增資發行新股將依相關法令規定辦理，其中10%保留由員工認購、10%採公開申購方式辦理，其餘80%由原股東按持股比例優先認購。實際發行價格將於本案向主管機關申報生效後，依相關法令規定及市場狀況訂定，並據以辦理後續繳款及發行作業。
paras_en: KGI Fund Holding (2883-TW) today (30th) had its board approve a cash capital increase by issuing common shares, limited to no more than 720 million shares, with an expected fundraising amount of about NT$200 billion to NT$250 billion. The actual amount raised will depend on the final issue price, and more than 70% of the funds will be allocated to KGI Securities.

KGI Fund Holding said it benefits from the AI industry driving Taiwan’s economic growth and a continuously active capital market, with steady growth in corporate financing, wealth management, and financial product trading demand. To seize market opportunities and fund business expansion, over 70% of the capital raised will be invested in KGI Securities to further strengthen business development and market competitiveness. This move will not only expand the core business scale but also improve the group’s capital utilization efficiency and future profit growth momentum.

KGI Securities reported strong business momentum in the first eight months of this year, with cumulative after‑tax net profit reaching NT$22.754 billion, a record high for the same period, up 235% year‑on‑year, and an annualized return on equity of 44%, leading peers. In investment banking, deep involvement in AI and semiconductor core industries yielded a market‑share of nearly 40% in underwriting volume for the first eight months, keeping it at the top of the market; wealth management continued to expand in Taiwan and Hong Kong with robust revenue growth; derivative and stock option trading also flexibly captured market opportunities, continuously contributing to profit.

KGI Fund Holding said the capital increase not only provides the capital needed for KGI Securities’ future business development but also demonstrates the group’s ongoing strategy of optimizing capital allocation and focusing on high‑growth, high‑capital‑efficiency businesses. Going forward, it will continue prudent yet proactive capital management to strengthen core competitive advantages and enhance overall group profitability and shareholder value.

The new shares from this cash capital increase will be issued in accordance with relevant regulations, with 10% reserved for employee subscription, 10% offered through a public offering, and the remaining 80% allocated to existing shareholders on a pro‑rata basis. The actual issue price will be set after the filing is approved by regulators, based on applicable laws and market conditions, and will guide subsequent payment and issuance procedures.

items.title: 華航釋空服職缺 10/5起報名 最快明年1月中旬報到
items.title_en: China Airlines Opens Flight Attendant Vacancies, Applications Start Oct 5, Earliest Reporting Mid‑January Next Year
paras: 華航(2610-TW)宣布啟動 2026 下半年徵才計畫，隨著陸續引進新世代機隊並擴張全球航網，預計招募合計逾百名客艙組員和貨運營運人員。
華航表示，積極充實空服團隊，本次客艙組員招募將於 10 月 5 日至 12 日開放報名，初試和複試預計分別在 11 月 7 日及 11 月 14 日舉行，報名者須具備教育部認可學士學位以上學歷，以及多益聽讀 600 分以上或同等英語成績，錄取者最快明年 1 月中旬起陸續報到。
同時，華航深耕航空貨運市場，同步招募貨運營運人員，報名時間自 10 月 1 日起至 10 月 14 日，職務內容涵蓋管理全球客貨機航班貨運作業，包括平衡表製作和盤櫃規劃等。
華航居台灣航空貨運市場領先地位，正積極強化業務競爭力，今年已率先推出生成式 AI 貨運客服，並進一步擴充智慧訂位等功能，朝更高效率的工作模式邁進。
華航擁有完善教育訓練制度和職涯發展環境，提供員工和眷屬優待機票、社團活動、心理諮商和運動活動等，兼顧專業成長與生活品質，為配合營運發展需求，也將陸續開放各項職缺招募。
paras_en: China Airlines (2610‑TW) announced the launch of its 2026 second‑half recruitment drive. With the gradual introduction of a new‑generation fleet and the expansion of its global network, the airline plans to hire more than one hundred cabin crew members and cargo operation staff.

China Airlines said it is actively strengthening its flight‑attendant team. This cabin‑crew recruitment will accept applications from October 5 to October 12, with the first and second interviews scheduled for November 7 and November 14 respectively. Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or higher recognized by the Ministry of Education and have a TOEIC listening‑reading score of at least 600 or an equivalent English qualification. Successful candidates could begin reporting as early as mid‑January next year.

At the same time, China Airlines, which is deepening its presence in the air‑cargo market, is also hiring cargo operation personnel. Applications are open from October 1 to October 14, and the roles cover management of global passenger‑and‑cargo flight cargo operations, including balance‑sheet preparation and container‑planning.

China Airlines, the leader in Taiwan’s air‑cargo market, is actively enhancing its competitive edge. This year it pioneered a generative‑AI‑powered cargo customer‑service system and is further expanding smart‑booking functions, moving toward a more efficient work model.

China Airlines offers a comprehensive education‑training system and career‑development environment, providing employees and their families with preferential tickets, club activities, psychological counseling, and sports programs. Balancing professional growth with quality of life, the airline will continue to open various job openings to meet operational development needs.

This cabin‑crew recruitment will accept applications from October 5 to October 12, with the first and second interviews scheduled for November 7 and November 14 respectively. Applicants must hold a bachelor’s degree or higher recognized by the Ministry of Education and have a TOEIC listening‑reading score of at least 600 or an equivalent English qualification. Successful candidates could begin reporting as early as mid‑January next year.

At the same time, China Airlines, which is deepening its presence in the air‑cargo market, is also hiring cargo operation personnel. Applications are open from October 1 to October 14, and the roles cover management of global passenger‑and‑cargo flight cargo operations, including balance‑sheet preparation and container‑planning.

China Airlines, the leader in Taiwan’s air‑cargo market, is actively enhancing its competitive edge. This year it pioneered a generative‑AI‑powered cargo customer‑service system and is further expanding smart‑booking functions, moving toward a more efficient work model.

China Airlines offers a comprehensive education‑training system and career‑development environment, providing employees and their families with preferential tickets, club activities, psychological counseling, and sports programs. Balancing professional growth with quality of life, the airline will continue to open various job openings to meet operational development needs.

items.title: 資服業新兵報到 藍新資訊以AI維運平台搶占高門檻利基市場
items.title_en: New Entrant in the IT Services Sector: Blue New Information Seizes High‑Barrier Niche Market with AI Operations Platform
paras: 資訊服務業又有新兵報到，藍新資訊(6938-TW)將於10月1日舉辦上櫃前業績發表會，預計10月中旬掛牌上櫃，總經理楊璦如表示，已形成「建置帶動維護維運、維護維運帶動優化」的服務循環，過去三年維護維運合約年複合成長率約14.5%，三年平均合約存續率超過90%，持續性收入占營收比重達40%，成營運穩定的基礎，後續將聚焦客戶推動AI算力導入、混合雲架構升級和零信任資安治理的龐大商機。
藍新資訊從大型主機出發，主要服務ERP、MES、HIS、金融行業交易系統和資料庫等關鍵應用所需的資訊運作平台，涵蓋雲端、儲存、網路資安和AI，並由規劃、建置一路承接維護與維運，目前服務客戶超過400家，今年前8月合併營收4.29億元，年增26.24%。
藍新資訊說明，業務門檻偏高，在於政府機關、金融行業及大型企業的核心系統涉及跨平台架構、既有系統相容性和營運不中斷要求，供應商除須具備規劃和建置能力，更需長期累積實際維運經驗，而客戶一旦導入即不易更換，形成有別於一般系統整合商的競爭門檻。
技術面上，藍新資訊專業工程團隊逾90人，累積超過600張技術認證，集中於大型核心主機、雲端虛擬化、AI數據存儲和資訊安全四大領域，並與IBM、NetApp、HPE、Dell、Cisco、Palo Alto、F5及Veeam等國際原廠建立長期合作關係，多次取得原廠傑出夥伴獎項。
為強化AI布局，藍新資訊於去年已成立智能應用發展部，並取得多項AI伺服器、高階GPU運算平台及AI商業應用導入的銷售實績，今年上半年占營收比重快速成長至8%。
藍新科進一步說明，不同於單純銷售AI伺服器，藍新資訊將AI布局定位為既有企業IT架構的延伸，未來將聚焦政府、金融機構與大型企業核心系統，持續擴大發展高門檻、高黏著度的利基市場。
paras_en: Information services welcome a new player as Blue New Information (6938‑TW) will hold a pre‑listing performance briefing on October 1 and plans to list on the OTC market in mid‑October. General manager Yang Airu said the company has established a service cycle of “building drives maintenance and operations, maintenance and operations drive optimization.” Over the past three years, maintenance‑and‑operations contracts grew at a compound annual rate of about 14.5%, with an average contract renewal rate exceeding 90%. Recurring revenue now accounts for 40% of total sales, providing a stable operating foundation. Going forward, the firm will focus on large opportunities in AI compute adoption, hybrid‑cloud upgrades and zero‑trust security governance for its customers.

Blue New Information started from large‑scale mainframes, primarily providing the information‑operations platforms needed for critical applications such as ERP, MES, HIS, financial transaction systems and databases. Its offerings span cloud, storage, network security and AI, covering everything from planning and construction to ongoing maintenance and operations. The company now serves more than 400 customers and recorded combined revenue of NT$429 million for the first eight months of this year, a year‑over‑year increase of 26.24%.

The company explained that the high entry barrier stems from the core systems of government agencies, financial institutions and large enterprises, which involve cross‑platform architectures, legacy system compatibility and uninterrupted operation requirements. Suppliers must not only have planning and implementation capabilities but also long‑term, hands‑on operational experience. Once a client adopts the solution, switching vendors is difficult, creating a competitive moat distinct from typical system integrators.

On the technical side, Blue New Information’s professional engineering team exceeds 90 staff and holds more than 600 technical certifications, focusing on four major domains: large‑scale core mainframes, cloud virtualization, AI data storage and information security. The firm has long‑term partnerships with international vendors such as IBM, NetApp, HPE, Dell, Cisco, Palo Alto, F5 and Veeam, and has repeatedly earned outstanding partner awards from these manufacturers.

To strengthen its AI positioning, Blue New Information established an Intelligent Application Development Department last year and has secured multiple sales of AI servers, high‑end GPU computing platforms and AI business‑application implementations. In the first half of this year, AI‑related revenue grew rapidly to represent 8% of total sales.

Blue New Information further clarified that, unlike pure AI‑server sales, its AI strategy is framed as an extension of existing enterprise IT architectures. Going forward, the company will concentrate on core systems of governments, financial institutions and large enterprises, continuously expanding its high‑barrier, high‑stickiness niche market.

items.title: 全球央行掀去美元購金潮 兆豐009832掌握黃金槓桿爆發力
items.title_en: Global Central Banks Spark Gold Buying Wave, Mega Financial 009832 Captures Gold Leverage Power
paras: 全球金融市場迎來多元配置新時代！在去美元化趨勢成形、地緣政治避險情緒升溫，以及美國聯準會重啟降息循環等推波助瀾下，全球央行自 2020 年起掀起強勁的「購金熱潮」。法人指出，隨著實質利率走低與地緣政治風險加劇，國際頂尖投行對金價後市看法極度樂觀，摩根大通預估 2027 年金價將上看每盎司 6,300 美元，更有中小型券商喊出 8,600 美元的天價。看好黃金產業槓桿效應，兆豐投信推出全台首檔黃金礦業 ETF—兆豐美國黃金礦業 ETF(009832-TW)。
兆豐美國黃金礦業 ETF 經理人吳朋鴻表示，黃金具備「避險資產首選、長期儲存價值、無主權違約風險」三大核心特性。自 2008 年金融海嘯後，美國經歷四次量化寬鬆(QE)，導致美元購買力大幅縮水；加上俄烏戰爭與中東地緣政治衝突等因素，許多新興市場央行(如中國、土耳其、巴西)為防範美元資產遭凍結，紛紛減少美債與美元儲備，進而大舉轉向增持無法憑空印製的黃金。
根據 2026 年中央銀行黃金儲備調查，高達 84% 受訪央行預計未來五年將繼續提高黃金佔總儲備的比率。歐洲央行(ECB)資料亦顯示，歐洲各央行黃金配置比率已從 20% 飆升至 27%，在央行買盤長線護盤與稀缺性撐腰下，奠定了黃金資產的長線戰略地位。
面對黃金投資熱潮，吳朋鴻強調，投資黃金已從 1.0 的實體金條(保管難、無利息)與 2.0 的黃金存折/期貨 ETF(交易成本高、無配息)，演進至 3.0 的「黃金礦業 ETF」。
黃金礦業股票具備獨特的「營運槓桿效應」，以「麵包店」概念舉例，黃金價格如同麵包售價，金礦公司則是生產麵包的企業。當國際金價上漲，而開採成本控制得宜時，企業獲利呈倍數擴大，帶動公司 EPS 與評價面(P/E)雙提升。
歷史數據驗證，在 2019 年至 2025 年間，國際金價平均年漲 20.6%，但 009832 追蹤的「NYSE TIP 美國黃金礦業指數」年均漲幅達 35.5%；2025 年金價大漲 64.6% 時，該指數更飆升 163.5%，展現遠高於金價的價格彈性與爆發力。
009832 追蹤 NYSE TIP 美國黃金礦業指數精選 55 檔在美國掛牌、市值達標(7.5 億美元以上)的高純度金銀龍頭企業，黃金約占 90.2%、白銀占 9.8%。
009832 前十大成分股囊括全球三大黃金生產商(如道瓊成分股 Newmont、Barric 等)，同時納入兼具 AI 與光伏剛性需求的白銀龍頭。更特別的是，成分股包含被譽為「礦業銀行家」的貴金屬權利金與金屬分潤公司(如 Wheaton)。這類公司提供礦商融資，並得以極高折扣價(如以每盎司 400 美元取得市場價 4,000 美元的黃金)獲取成品，在金價多頭格局下，獲利更具爆發性成長力。
paras_en: Global financial markets are ushering in a new era of diversified allocation! Driven by the formation of a de‑dollarisation trend, heightened geopolitical‑risk hedging sentiment, and the U.S. Federal Reserve’s restart of a rate‑cut cycle, central banks worldwide have launched a strong “gold‑buying frenzy” since 2020. Analysts note that with real rates falling and geopolitical risks intensifying, top international investment banks are extremely bullish on gold’s outlook – JPMorgan projects gold to reach $6,300 per ounce by 2027, and some boutique brokers even quote a sky‑high $8,600. Seeing the leverage effect of the gold industry, Mega Financial Investment Trust introduced Taiwan’s first gold‑mining ETF – Mega US Gold Mining ETF (009832‑TW).

Mega US Gold Mining ETF manager Wu Peng‑hong says gold possesses three core attributes: “the top‑choice hedge asset, long‑term store of value, and no sovereign default risk.” Since the 2008 financial crisis, the U.S. has undergone four rounds of quantitative easing, eroding the dollar’s purchasing power. Coupled with the Russia‑Ukraine war and Middle‑East geopolitical tensions, many emerging‑market central banks (e.g., China, Turkey, Brazil) have reduced U.S. Treasury and dollar reserves to avoid asset freezes, shifting heavily toward gold, which cannot be printed out of thin air.

According to the 2026 central‑bank gold‑reserve survey, a staggering 84% of respondents expect to increase gold’s share of total reserves over the next five years. ECB data also show that European central banks’ gold allocation has jumped from 20% to 27%, cementing gold’s long‑term strategic position under sustained central‑bank buying and scarcity support.

Facing the gold‑investment boom, Wu Peng‑hong emphasizes that gold investing has evolved from 1.0 physical bars (hard to store, no interest) and 2.0 gold accounts/futures ETFs (high transaction costs, no dividends) to 3.0 “gold‑mining ETFs.”

Gold‑mining stocks exhibit a unique operating‑leverage effect. Using a “bakery” analogy, gold price is like the price of bread, and mining companies are the bakers. When international gold prices rise while extraction costs are well‑controlled, profits multiply, boosting both EPS and valuation multiples (P/E).

Historical data show that from 2019 to 2025, global gold prices rose an average of 20.6% per year, whereas the “NYSE TIP US Gold Mining Index” tracked by 009832 posted a 35.5% annual gain. In 2025, when gold surged 64.6%, the index jumped 163.5%, demonstrating price elasticity and explosive growth far exceeding the metal itself.

009832 tracks the NYSE TIP US Gold Mining Index, which selects 55 high‑purity gold‑silver leaders listed in the U.S. with market caps above $750 million. The portfolio is roughly 90.2% gold and 9.8% silver.

The fund’s top ten holdings include the world’s three largest gold producers (e.g., Newmont and Barrick, both Dow Jones components) and silver leaders with AI and photovoltaic demand. Notably, the basket also contains precious‑metal royalty and streaming firms (e.g., Wheaton), dubbed “mining bankers.” These companies finance miners and acquire metal at deep discounts (e.g., $400 per ounce for market‑price $4,000 gold), delivering explosive profit potential in a bullish gold environment.

items.title: 美國連11年蟬聯我國銀曝險最大國 占總債務比重破3成創新高
items.title_en: United States Leads Taiwan's Bank Exposure for 11 Consecutive Years, Share of Total Debt Tops 30% at a Record High
paras: 台灣央行今(30)日公布6月底本國銀行國家風險統計，美國連續44個季度蟬聯我國曝險最大國，曝險金額達2225.28億美元，占總債務比重30.28%也創歷史新高。
央行指出，儘管國銀對中國曝險仍居第三，但美中曝險的差距額持續擴大，主要是因對美國有價證券投資增加、以及存放款增加，隨著台灣科技業者赴美擴大投資，後續持續關注。
央行統計，截至6月底本國銀行依直接交易對手基礎統計的外國債權餘額為7350億美元，較第一季底增加4.61%，主要因對非銀行的私人部門債權增加。
我國曝險前10大國家(地區)依序為美國、盧森堡、中國大陸、澳大利亞、日本、香港、英國、新加坡、法國和越南，合計5466億美元，順序較上季並未有改變，占直接交易對手基礎外國債權餘額74.37%，較上季增加0.83個百分點。
paras_en: Taiwan’s central bank today (30th) released its national risk statistics for domestic banks as of the end of June. The United States has topped Taiwan’s exposure rankings for 44 consecutive quarters, with exposure amounting to US$222.528 billion, representing 30.28% of total debt – a historic high.

The central bank noted that although domestic banks’ exposure to China remains the third‑largest, the gap with the United States is widening, driven by increased investments in U.S. securities and higher deposits. With Taiwanese technology firms expanding investments in the United States, the bank will continue to monitor the situation closely.

According to the bank’s statistics, as of the end of June domestic banks’ foreign‑credit balances, measured on a direct counterparty basis, stood at US$735 billion, up 4.61% from the end of the first quarter, mainly due to higher credit to non‑bank private‑sector entities.

The top ten countries/regions of Taiwan’s exposure are, in order, the United States, Luxembourg, Mainland China, Australia, Japan, Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, Singapore, France and Vietnam, totaling US$546.6 billion. The ranking order is unchanged from the previous quarter, accounting for 74.37% of foreign‑credit balances on a direct counterparty basis, an increase of 0.83 percentage points from the prior quarter.

items.title: TNCAP公告Q3安全評等 MG ZS第2版評等獲零顆星
items.title_en: TNCAP Announces Q3 Safety Rating: MG ZS 2nd Edition Receives Zero Stars
paras: 台灣新車安全評等制度(TNCAP)今(30)公布今(2026)年第3季新車安全評等，此次受評車型為MG ZS僅獲得零顆星。車安中心表示，MG ZS在撞擊測試時發現座椅側方空氣囊未正確展開、後座座椅椅墊左側脫開及電瓶負極樁頭脫開等異常，後續將要求中華汽車(2204-TW)提出改善措施，並依規定辦理召回改正作業。
TNCAP原先規劃第3季將公布MG ZS及VOLVO XC40等2款車型評等結果，但今日僅先公布MG ZS評等結果，原排定第5順位的VOLVO車型將延至今年第4季公布。
TNCAP表示，本次MG ZS 車型依「交通部執行台灣新車安全評等作業要點」及「交通部台灣新車安全評等規章第二版」執行TNCAP 主動、被動安全試驗，辦理完成計分及轉換星級評等後，公告MG ZS於四大安全領域得分率中分別獲得成人保護56%、兒童保護89%、弱勢道路使用者保護45%及安全輔助25%，依據星級評等平衡標準規定，整體星級評等為零顆星。
TNCAP也說明，本次MG ZS 車型在執行比強制性安全法規更為嚴苛之TNCAP 側方撞擊及側方立柱撞擊二項試驗後，皆發現側方保護空氣囊未能正確開展，影響乘員胸部、腹部及骨盆的保護性。
另在TNCAP前方全寬撞擊試驗MG ZS過程中，發現後排座椅椅墊左側及電瓶負極樁頭皆有脫開情形，車安中心表示，後續請中華汽車(2204-TW)公司善盡企業責任研提改善措施，並依交通部汽車安全性調查召回改正及監督管理辦法辦理召回改正作業，以提升行車安全。
paras_en: Taiwan's New Car Assessment Program (TNCAP) released its third‑quarter 2026 safety ratings today, with the MG ZS receiving zero stars. The vehicle safety center noted that during crash testing the side airbag failed to deploy correctly, the left side of the rear seat cushion detached, and the negative battery terminal came loose. TNCAP will require China Motor Corp. (2204‑TW) to propose corrective measures and to conduct a recall in accordance with regulations.

TNCAP had originally planned to announce the ratings for two models, the MG ZS and the Volvo XC40, in the third quarter, but today only the MG ZS rating was released. The Volvo model, which was slated for the fifth position, will have its results postponed to the fourth quarter of this year.

TNCAP stated that the MG ZS was evaluated under the Ministry of Transportation’s guidelines for the Taiwan New Car Assessment Program and the second edition of its regulations, covering both active and passive safety tests. After scoring and converting to star ratings, the MG ZS achieved protection scores of 56% for adult occupants, 89% for child occupants, 45% for vulnerable road users, and 25% for safety assistance, resulting in an overall rating of zero stars according to the star‑rating balance criteria.

TNCAP also explained that in the more stringent side‑impact and side‑pole impact tests—beyond mandatory safety regulations—the MG ZS’s side airbags failed to deploy properly, compromising protection for occupants’ chest, abdomen and pelvis.

During the full‑width frontal impact test, the MG ZS showed detachment of the left side of the rear seat cushion and the negative battery terminal. The vehicle safety center said China Motor Corp. (2204‑TW) must fulfill its corporate responsibility by developing improvement measures and carry out a recall under the Ministry of Transportation’s vehicle safety investigation and recall supervision regulations to enhance driving safety.

items.title: 〈台幣〉季底拋匯支持微升收31.852元 月、季線同步翻黑
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Ends Month Slightly Higher at 31.852, Month and Quarter Lines Turn Negative
paras: 台北股匯今(30)日同步收月線、季線，呈現股匯雙漲，新台幣兌美元匯率終場收在 31.852 元、升值 2.4 分，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 28.17 億美元。9 月單月累計貶值1.86角、貶幅0.58%，月線翻黑，第三季累計貶值 1.5 分或 0.05%，季線同步翻黑。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為 31.85 元，外資呈現雙向進出，不過，出口商把握季底最後一個交易日拋匯，使得匯價最高來到 31.805 元，尾盤升幅收斂，收在 31.852 元，升值 2.4 分。
台股今天展開反彈，一度勁揚逾 700 點，但台積電漲幅回吐，加權指數再度失守4萬8千點大關，留下上影線，但仍守住五日線，收在47,940.13點，上漲308.17點，外資買超 308.56 億美元。
觀察主要貨幣今天表現，根據央行統計，美元指數小跌 0.08%，韓元升值 0.44%，日元升值 0.31%，星幣升值 0.18%，新台幣升值 0.08%，人民幣則小貶 0.01%。
投資人關注美國周三公布的8月個人消費支出物價指數(PCE)，這項數據受到聯準會密切關注，接下來周五即將公布9月非農就業報告。
paras_en: The Taipei stock and foreign exchange markets closed today (30th) simultaneously on the monthly and quarterly lines, showing a dual rise in stocks and currency. The New Taiwan dollar ended the session at 31.852 per US dollar, appreciating 0.024, with total turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign exchange markets reaching $2.817 billion. For September alone the currency depreciated 0.186 NTD (0.58%), turning the monthly line negative, while for the third quarter it fell 0.015 NTD (0.05%), also turning the quarterly line negative.

The New Taiwan dollar opened today at 31.85 per US dollar. Foreign investors were active on both sides, but exporters seized the last trading day of the quarter to sell foreign exchange, pushing the rate up to a high of 31.805. The gain narrowed toward the close, ending at 31.852, a rise of 0.024.
